tiers.name: Easy
items: Tinderbox
Wolfbane (or any version of the reforged Sunspear after River of Blood)
Druid pouch (with charges)
Silver sickle (b) or Ivandis flail
Limpwurt seed (strongly advised to plant the Limpwurt before any other achievements are done)
Ring of charos, Ring of charos (a) or Ring of charos (a)(i)

tasks.name: Chisellin' Conchiolin
tasks.desc: Craft your own snelm in Morytania.
tasks.notes: Craft a snelm in Morytania by killing any snail in the Mort Myre Swamp and using a chisel on its shell.

tasks.name: It's Only Wafer Thin
tasks.desc: Cook a thin snail in Morytania.
tasks.notes: Cook a thin snail in Morytania. There's a cooking range in Port Phasmatys, and there are many dead trees from which logs can be chopped and lit to make a fire.

tasks.name: Dislike-Anthrope
tasks.desc: Kill a werewolf in its human form using the wolfbane dagger whilst in Canifis.
tasks.notes:
Kill a werewolf in its human form using the wolfbane dagger whilst in Canifis.
As the wolfbane dagger is a melee weapon, players should not wear range or magic gear that lowers melee hit chance. This will prevent them from doing any damage while wielding the wolfbane dagger. Melee armour is recommended for this task. It is not possible to complete the achievement while dual wielding another weapon with the wolfbane dagger.
If dropped or lost, the dagger can be reclaimed by talking to Drezel in the basement of Paterdomus. Any version of the reforged Sunspear can be used after River of Blood.
The achievement can no longer be done without the dagger by killing the target in a single hit, preventing the transformation. The max hit for a human is 1000, after which it transforms into its werewolf state.

tasks.name: Cranius Lupus
tasks.desc: Finish a game of Werewolf Skullball.
tasks.notes: Finish a game of Werewolf Skullball. Remember to bring the ring of charos which is required to enter the course.

tasks.name: Lab Clean-up Assistant
tasks.desc: Kill an experiment under Castle Fenkenstrain.
tasks.notes: Kill an experiment under Fenkenstrain's Castle. Go to the graveyard south-east of Fenkenstrain's Castle. Push the grave furthest from the castle to enter the area below the castle.

tasks.name: Fortified Spirit
tasks.desc: Restore and boost your prayer points at the altar in the Nature Grotto.
tasks.notes:
Restore and boost one's prayer points at the altar in the Nature Grotto.
Partially drained prayer points will work.

tasks.name: Struck A-Ghast
tasks.desc: Kill a ghast in Morytania.
tasks.notes:
Kill a ghast in Morytania.
Players will need a full druid pouch to make the ghast attackable. Killing ghasts in Temple Trekking does count towards this achievement.

tasks.name: Blooming Marvellous
tasks.desc: Using either a Silver Sickle or the Ivandis Flail, grow some fungus in the swamp using Bloom.
tasks.notes:
Grow some fungus in the Mort Myre Swamp using the Bloom option of either a blessed silver sickle or the Ivandis flail.
40 prayer points are required to cast the spell. Players can recharge their prayer points at the altar in the Nature Grotto after completion of the Nature Spirit quest.
Temple Trekking provides a short-cut to the Grotto as a reward.

tasks.name: Only Going Forward. We Can't Find Reverse
tasks.desc: Take an easy companion through an easy route of Temple Trekking.
tasks.notes:
Take an easy companion through an easy route of Temple Trekking.
Simply choose an easy companion at the Temple Trekking start point, and guide them through an easy route. Players can continue if they teleported out before and still get the achievement done. Sometimes it won't count unless the continue-easy path button was clicked.

tasks.name: If It Bleeds...
tasks.desc: Kill anything on the ground floor of the Slayer Tower.
tasks.notes:
Kill anything on the ground floor (UK) / 1st floor (US) of the Slayer Tower.
Bats count if they are inside the tower, though the double agent from Treasure Trails does not.

tasks.name: Wurt A Bundle
tasks.desc: Harvest limpwurt in the farming patch near Port Phasmatys.
tasks.notes:
Harvest a limpwurt root in the flower patch near Port Phasmatys.
It's ideal to start the achievement by planting a limpwurt seed at the flower patch first. Using supercompost is recommended. Alternatively, a Supreme growth potion (leafy) can also be used to instantly grow the plant.

reward.intro:
Talk to Hiylik Myna, who is located east of Paterdomus, to claim the rewards for the easy achievement set:
Furthermore, Explorer Jack rewards 10–4,096 coins per completed achievement.
items: An antique lamp granting 4,000 experience (in the skill of choice of level 25 or higher)
Morytania legs 1, which grants the following bonuses:
perks: Double fungi when casting Bloom
50% chance of a ghast ignoring players rather than attacking them
5% extra Temple Trekking rewards

tiers.name: Medium
other: A Fairy Tale II - Cure a Queen (partial)
items: 5 Ecto-tokens (2 more if you haven't completed Ghosts Ahoy)
Pot
Ectophial
Ghostspeak amulet or Cramulet
Flamtaer hammer
A good hatchet recommended
Shade key
Rope
Small fishing net
Restore potion (or the ingredients to make it, a 3 dose potion is needed)
Garlic
Silver dust (a silver bar ground by the grinder at Ectofuntus)
4 apple mush OR 2 Bucket of water, 2 Barley malt, and an ale main ingredient
Law rune and air rune (for telekinetic grab)
Steel bar (can be in metal bank)
Ammo mould
Bittercap mushroom spore (recommended you plant the seed before starting other achievements)
Serum 207 or serum 208 (if Razmire is afflicted)
Crystal-mine key or the steel key ring (if the key is on the ring) or if you go all the way to the bottom of the mine adjacent to Crystal outcrop

tasks.name: Charter A Course
tasks.desc: Take a trip on a charter ship to the Port Phasmatys dock.
tasks.notes:
Take a trip on a charter ship to the Port Phasmatys dock.
Some coins and having entered Port Phasmatys is required for this achievement. Ecto-tokens are not required when travelling by ship.
The cheapest charter is from Musa Point at 275 coins with a ring of charos (a) (1,100 coins without it).

tasks.name: Travelling On The Slime Trail
tasks.desc: Use an ectophial to return to Port Phasmatys.
tasks.notes:
Use an ectophial to return to Port Phasmatys.
If lost, the ectophial can be reclaimed from Velorina, the ghost who started the Ghosts Ahoy quest.

tasks.name: The Yeast They Can Do
tasks.desc: Exchange ecto-tokens for brewing yeast with Metarialus in The Green Ghost inn's cellar.
tasks.notes:
Exchange 5 ecto-tokens for brewing yeast with Metarialus in the The Green Ghost inn's cellar while having an empty pot in the inventory.
A ghostspeak amulet or cramulet is not required to purchase yeast from Metarialus if using the right-click 'buy yeast' option.
Players may wish to keep or use the yeast for the The Beer Inn-spectre task in the same area.

tasks.name: Flamtaer Will Get You Everywhere
tasks.desc: Use a Flamtaer hammer to help fix the Shades of Mort'ton temple.
tasks.notes:
Use a Flamtaer hammer to help fix the Shades of Mort'ton temple.
The Flamtaer hammer can be purchased from Razmire Keelgan in Mort'ton for 13,000 coins.

tasks.name: Who You Gonna Ring?
tasks.desc: Use the fairy rings to travel to the Haunted Woods.
quests: A Fairy Tale II - Cure a Queen
tasks.notes:
Use the fairy rings to travel to fairy ring ALQ in the Haunted Woods.
A dramen staff or lunar staff is required to use the fairy ring network unless A Fairy Tale III - Battle at Ork's Rift has been completed.

tasks.name: Barking Up the Wrong Tree
tasks.desc: Obtain some bark from hollow trees.
tasks.notes:
Obtain some bark from hollow trees.
Hollow trees are located east of Canifis in the Haunted Woods. It may take several attempts to get bark; most of the time nothing is obtained.
Keep the bark, there is a hard achievement, Better Than Cursing The Darkness, that needs it.

tasks.name: Gate Spectre-ations
tasks.desc: Enter through the western gate of Port Phasmatys.
tasks.notes: Enter through the western gate of Port Phasmatys which requires either 2 ecto-tokens and a ghostspeak amulet or completion of Ghosts Ahoy.

tasks.name: Ready? Trek!
tasks.desc: Take a medium companion through a medium route of Temple Trekking.
tasks.notes:
Take a medium companion through a medium route of Temple Trekking.
Simply choose a medium companion at the Temple Trekking start point. Make sure to select 'Confirm' rather than 'Quick Start', otherwise the achievement will not prompt. And guide them through a medium route. Sometimes it won't count unless the continue-medium path button was clicked.

tasks.name: Don't Stop Me If I Start To Ramble
tasks.desc: Complete a Burgh de Rott Ramble.
tasks.notes: Complete a Temple Trekking route from Paterdomus to Burgh de Rott.

tasks.name: Plenty Mort Where That Came From
tasks.desc: Unlock a chest in the Shade Catacombs.
tasks.notes: Unlock a chest in the Shade Catacombs. See this for more information.

tasks.name: Izzy Wizzy Let's Get Lizzy
tasks.desc: Trap a green salamander in the Haunted Woods.
tasks.notes:
Trap a green salamander in the Haunted Woods.
Players will need a rope and a small fishing net for the net trap (the net on the tool belt does not work).
The hunting area is marked by a Hunter Training symbol on the map, it's directly south of the entrance to the Werewolf Skullball minigame.

tasks.name: Finding Your Balance
tasks.desc: Mix a Guthix Balance potion while in Morytania.
tasks.notes:
Mix a Guthix balance potion while in Morytania.
Add garlic to a 3-dose restore potion, then add silver dust. Silver dust is obtained by grinding silver bars in the bone grinder on the upper floor of the Ectofuntus. If the garlic is obtained from the chest in the Myreque Hideout in Burgh de Rott, do not create the potion just yet. Making the potion in the hideout does not count as being in Morytania.

tasks.name: The Beer Inn-spectre
tasks.desc: Start any ale brewing below the Green Ghost Inn.
tasks.notes:
Start any ale brewing below The Green Ghost Inn.
Required are 2 buckets of water, 2 barley malt, ale yeast and the main ingredient for the ale one wants to brew.
Cider does work to complete this achievement. For this, the players need 4 buckets of apple mush (4 buckets and 16 cooking apples), and ale yeast, but not the buckets of water or the barley malt.

tasks.name: Brain Bending
tasks.desc: Telegrab the pickled brain on a table in the Hair of the Dog.
tasks.notes: Use the Telekinetic Grab spell to pick up the pickled brain on a table in the Hair of the Dog bar in Canifis. This requires 1 law rune and 1 air rune and the player needs to be on the standard spellbook.

tasks.name: I Wonder How Far It Ghost?
tasks.desc: Explore the tunnel from the cellar under the Hair of the Dog.
tasks.notes:
Explore the tunnel from the cellar under the Hair of the Dog bar in Canifis.
The tunnel is located under a trapdoor at the back of the Hair of the Dog inn, not inside. If the tunnel shortcut is unlocked by levelling Zachory Bragg to 99 in the Temple Trekking minigame, players may have to toggle the trapdoor's function back to normal.
Players can also enter the tunnel from the opposite direction in the Mort Myre Swamp.

tasks.name: Obvious Forgery
tasks.desc: Make a batch of cannonballs in Port Phasmatys.
tasks.notes: Make a batch of cannonballs in Port Phasmatys requiring one steel bar and an ammo mould which can be on the tool belt.

tasks.name: The Higher, The Badder
tasks.desc: Kill anything on the first floor (upstairs) of the Slayer Tower.
tasks.notes: Kill anything on the 1st floor (UK) / 2nd floor (US) of the Slayer Tower.

tasks.name: Fun Guy But Bitter
tasks.desc: Harvest bittercap mushrooms in the farming patch near Canifis.
tasks.notes:
Harvest bittercap mushrooms in the mushroom patch west of Canifis which requires a bittercap mushroom spore.
This can take up to 240 minutes (4 hours) to grow, however this can be expedited by using a supreme growth potion (sundry) obtained from the player-owned farm for 1000 beans, or from Sydekix's Shop of Balance for 7,500 Crux Eqal favour. Players may use boosts to complete this achievement, such as pork pie at Farming level 48, but they must be redone before harvesting to complete the achievement.

tasks.name: Polterheist
tasks.desc: Mine the mithril vein in the north-west corner of level 2 of the Abandoned Mine.
tasks.notes:
Mine the mithril vein in the north-west corner of level 2 of the Abandoned Mine.
The mithril vein is on the northern wall, near the western large door.
A crystal-mine key (steel key ring with the key added works) is required. Climb down the stairs found on the surface at the north-east part of the Abandoned Mine, open the large doors to the west. Mine the mithril ore vein on the northern wall.

tasks.name: Ad-Myre The Goods
tasks.desc: View the stock in Razmire Builders' Merchants shop.
tasks.notes: View the stock in Razmire Builders' Merchants shop. Must use serum 207 or serum 208 on Razmire Keelgan to gain access to the shop.

reward.intro:
If the previous tiers of the area tasks have also been completed: Talk to Robin, who is located in The Green Ghost inn in Port Phasmatys, to claim the rewards for the medium achievement set:
Furthermore, Explorer Jack rewards 10–4,096 coins per completed achievement.
items: An antique lamp granting 10,000 experience (in the skill of choice of level 46 or higher)
Morytania legs 2, which, in addition to Morytania legs 1's bonuses, grants the following bonuses:
perks: Each essence has a 10% chance of gaining a second blood rune at the blood altar[note 1]
Smithing time of regular cannonballs is reduced from 7 ticks to 4 ticks in Port Phasmatys
Teleport to the slime pit under the Ectofuntus, 5 times daily
Robin will convert up to 13 sets of any bones into corresponding bonemeal and provide 13 free buckets of slime per day; noted bones are accepted
Razmire offers free planks weekly – a choice of 10 teak, 20 oak or 30 planks
Pyre log storage chests in Mort'ton become available
The mushroom patch near Canifis will no longer become diseased
Haunted tools in the Abandoned Mine are no longer aggressive
Olive oil bought from Razmire General Store comes in 4 doses instead of 3

tiers.name: Hard
other: 65 Agility Agility (b) (Can be boosted, but 63 Agility is required for The Branches of Darkmeyer.)
The combat stats required for the Barrows gear you choose.
items: Blood altar teleport tablet
Ivandis flail (with at least 200 burnt Vyre corpses)
One piece of Barrows gear
A Columbarium key
Blisterwood logs and 2 Silver sickles
A piece of bark
Ring of fire
Ring of charos

tasks.name: Detarnation
tasks.desc: Kill Tarn Razorlor (or visit his lair if he's already dead).
tasks.notes:
Kill Tarn Razorlor (or visit his lair if he's already dead).
Players may use a ring of slaying for quick access.

tasks.name: Runecraft Carrier
tasks.desc: Break a Blood Altar teletablet.
tasks.notes:
Break a blood altar teleport tablet which can be bought at the Runecrafting Guild for 45 Runecrafting guild tokens, or from Wizard Rinsit's Runecrafting Shop for 2,000 Runespan points.
The level for the Runecrafting requirement can be boosted, either by talking to Oldak, or by using spicy stews.

tasks.name: Shade-Shattering Ka-Bloom
tasks.desc: Cast Bloom using a Flail of Ivandis, upgraded with at least 200 burnt vyre corpses.
tasks.notes: Cast Bloom using an Ivandis flail, upgraded with at least 200 burnt vyre corpses.

tasks.name: They'll Just Throw It Away Again
tasks.desc: Hand in your stick at the end of the Werewolf Agility Course.
tasks.notes: Hand in the stick at the end of the Werewolf Agility Course. Accessing the course requires a ring of charos.

tasks.name: Time Salver
tasks.desc: Use the shortcut to cross the River Salve without going through the temple.
tasks.notes:
Use the broken Saradomin statue shortcut to cross the River Salve without going through the Paterdomus temple.
The shortcut can be crossed from either direction. A fast way to complete this achievement is to travel to fairy ring CKS and then running north-west.

tasks.name: Huge Success
tasks.desc: Attune your house portal to Kharyrll, or use yours if it has already been attuned.
tasks.notes:
Attune a teak, mahogany, or marble portal in a player-owned house to Kharyrll (modern day Canifis), or use the Canifis portal if it has already been attuned. Using a portal in another player's house will complete this achievement unless the player is an Ironman Mode player, in which case they must instead build and attune their own portal.
A Kharyrll portal may be assigned without needing the spellbook set to Ancient Magicks and requires 200 law runes, 100 blood runes, and level 66 Magic.
Using a portal nexus in a player-owned house will not work.

tasks.name: I Brought Your Stuff Back
tasks.desc: Equip one item from a set of Barrows gear in the Barrows.
other:
One of:
• 70 Attack Attack or
• 70 Ranged Ranged or
• 70 Magic Magic
tasks.notes: Equip any one item from a set of Barrows equipment in the Barrows. Equipment released alongside or after the Evolution of Combat will not work.

tasks.name: Just One More Key...
tasks.desc: Use a Columbarium key to unlock an alcove.
tasks.notes:
Use a columbarium key to unlock an alcove in the Columbarium underneath Paterdomus. Shiny columbarium keys also work for this achievement.
Not to be confused with cremating shades in Mort'ton, vyre cremation only happens in the Columbarium and requires a vyre corpse and one set of teak pyre logs or better.
Be aware that the Columbarium is not in Morytania, so do not attempt to perform other Morytania achievements there.

tasks.name: Raising The Stakes
tasks.desc: Fletch a blisterwood polearm within Morytania.
tasks.notes:
Fletch a blisterwood polearm within Morytania, requiring one set of blisterwood logs and two silver sickles.
The player must start and progress through The Branches of Darkmeyer to access the blisterwood tree, which is located in the arboretum in Darkmeyer. The quest requirements to start the quest are not boostable. Creating the polearm inside the Myreque Hideout in Meiyerditch will not count.

tasks.name: Trekkin' Ain't Easy
tasks.desc: Take a hard companion through a hard route of Temple Trekking.
tasks.notes:
Take a hard companion through a hard route of Temple Trekking or Burgh de Rott Ramble.
Simply choose a hard companion at the Temple Trekking or Burgh de Rott Ramble start point, and guide them through a hard route. Make sure to select 'Confirm' rather than 'Quick Start', otherwise the achievement will not prompt. There seems to be a chance of the achievement not awarding (even when selecting 'Confirm'), so several attempts may have to be done.

tasks.name: Better Than Cursing The Darkness
tasks.desc: Burn a Haunted Wood torch while wearing the Ring of fire.
tasks.notes: Burn a Haunted Wood torch while wearing the ring of fire (from the All Fired Up minigame) and having a piece of bark in the inventory.

reward.intro:
If the previous tiers of the area tasks have also been completed: Talk to the strange old man, who is located at the Barrows mounds, to claim the rewards for the hard achievement set:
Furthermore, Explorer Jack rewards 10–4,096 coins per completed achievement.
items: An antique lamp granting 20,000 experience (in the skill of choice of level 65 or higher)
Morytania legs 3, which, in addition to Morytania legs 2's bonuses, grants the following bonuses:

Increased chance of gaining better shade keys when burning shades
50% chance that Blood altar teleports don't break on use
Teleport charges increased to 10 per day
Robin will convert up to 26 sets of bones and provide 26 free buckets of slime per day
All ghosts will talk to the players as if the ghostspeak amulet is equipped
Prayer drain is halved in the Barrows
Receive double runes from Barrows chests
10% more Temple Trekking rewards
Ability to bank Barrows chest loot directly from the reward chest
Access to a shortcut that leads to the Abandoned mine crystal outcrops
The Big Book o' Piracy now has a charge cap of 20 charges.

tiers.name: Elite
items: Drakan's medallion
Pure essence
Blood talisman or tiara
Ghast pouch
Morchella mushroom spore
Fellstalk seed
A Vial or a Vial of water
Magic pyre logs
A tinderbox
Food, armour and potions to fight all seven Barrows Brothers

tasks.name: Whip: It Good
tasks.desc: Kill an abyssal demon in the Slayer Tower.
tasks.notes: Kill an abyssal demon in the Slayer Tower. The achievement can not be completed using recoil damage.

tasks.name: As You Might Expect
tasks.desc: Craft blood runes at the Blood Altar.
tasks.notes:
Craft blood runes at the blood altar.
This achievement can be done as low as level 71 using spicy stew with three doses of orange spice after completion of Evil Dave's Big Day Out. Alternatively, using a more reliable temporary skill boost, it can be done at level 72 with the use of extreme runecrafting potions. It is also doable at level 75 by talking to Oldak, as he can boost the player's Runecrafting level by ±2, with time for them to use a blood altar teleport tablet.

tasks.name: Thoroughly A-Ghast
tasks.desc: Summon a ghast familiar in Morytania.
tasks.notes:
Summon a ghast familiar in Morytania. Though In Aid of the Myreque is listed as a requirement in-game, players must complete The Darkness of Hallowvale to unlock Burgh de Rott Ramble.
The ghast familiar may be claimed after getting all 6 followers in Temple Trekking and Burgh de Rott Ramble to level 99 (3 from Paterdomus to Burgh de Rott and 3 from Burgh de Rott to Paterdomus). This effectively makes Complete Trekky a requirement as well.

tasks.name: As Good As Renew
tasks.desc: Farm and mix the ingredients for a prayer renewal potion entirely in Morytania.
tasks.notes:
Farm and mix the ingredients for a prayer renewal potion entirely in Morytania.
Players must have the correct farming level to plant and harvest; otherwise, the partial achievement progress will not register.
A pork pie can be used at level 86 to achieve a +5 Farming boost, and spicy stews can be used for +6 Herblore boost.

subs.html: Fellstalk seed (level 91 Farming) requires planting and harvesting in the herb patch to the west of Port Phasmatys.
Morchella mushroom spores (level 74 Farming) requires planting and harvesting in the mushroom patch to the east of Paterdomus.
Finally, mix a clean fellstalk and a morchella mushroom into a vial of water.

tasks.name: Fremennik Export
tasks.desc: Fish shark barehanded off the Burgh de Rott dock.
tasks.notes:
Fish a raw shark using bare-handed fishing off the Burgh de Rott dock. Catching a raw great white shark at this location will work. Catching a shark with the Bait and Switch relic power will also count.
Temporary skill boosts may be used to complete this achievement; the admiral pie may be used at level 91 Fishing, and Strength boosts work as well.

tasks.name: Not Such a Rotten Idea
tasks.desc: Teleport to Burgh de Rott using a games necklace.
other: 500 companion levels from Temple Trekking

tasks.name: Set It On Fiyr
tasks.desc: Burn a fiyr shade with pyre wood.
tasks.notes:
Burn a fiyr remains with magic pyre logs or elder pyre logs.
Fiyr remains can be bought on the Grand Exchange or obtained by killing Fiyr Shades, found on the hard route in the Mort'ton event of Temple Trekking or in the Shade Catacombs below Mort'ton.
If a key drop is not obtained, the achievement will not count and it will need to be tried again.

tasks.name: Bros Before Barrows
tasks.desc: Defeat the first seven Barrows Brothers, including Akrisae.
tasks.notes:
Kill the first seven Barrows Brothers, including Akrisae the Doomed, but not Linza the Disgraced. They do not have to be killed in a single run, and Barrows amulets don't work.
See this page for strategies.

tasks.name: On Wings Of Bling
tasks.desc: Use Drakan's Medallion to teleport to Darkmeyer.
tasks.notes: Use Drakan's medallion to teleport to Darkmeyer.

reward.intro:
If the previous tiers of the area tasks have also been completed: Talk to Old Man Ral, who is located near the entrance of Meiyerditch, to claim the rewards for the elite achievement set:
Furthermore, Explorer Jack rewards 10–4,096 coins per completed achievement.
items: 2 antique lamps granting 50,000 experience each (in the skill of choice of level 80 or higher)
An antique lamp granting 40,000 experience (in the skill of choice of level 75 or higher)
Morytania legs 4, which, in addition to Morytania legs 3's bonuses, grants the following bonuses:
perks: 50% more Firemaking and Prayer experience from cremating vyre corpses (including with the Sunspear)
10% more Slayer experience for kills in the Slayer Tower while on a task
20% chance of creating a 4-dose prayer renewal instead of 3-dose while making them in Morytania[note 2]
Unlimited teleports to the slime pit under the Ectofuntus.
Robin will now convert 39 sets of bones and provide 39 free buckets of slime per day
Double yield from Canifis, Isafdar, City of Um and Linbog Village mushroom patches (experience is not doubled)
The ability to see Mune in Morytania on Thursdays and sometimes on Saturdays and/or Sundays if all Morytania achievements have been completed and all the rewards have been claimed
The Big Book o' Piracy now has a charge cap of 60 charges
